Method of Attack: Malware that forces ATMs to empty their cash dispensers by reading commands from a local command.txt file and executing them to dispense cash
Use of fileless malware and PowerShell scripts to escalate access and install ATM malware
Self-deleting malware that cleans up files after attack to avoid detection
Attack Vector: Exploitation of bank network vulnerabilities using legitimate Windows apps and PowerShell malware
Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) access to ATM management systems
Installation of malware on ATMs via compromised bank network systems
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of command.txt file with specific commands
Malware file named tv.dll found on ATM
Log entries showing cash dispensing commands and messages
